HC1_daily_signal_deep_history.description: Daily per-contract signal research over multi-year history (driver tables, regime splits, term structure, year-by-year stability).
framework_refs: 00_MASTER §6 (required tests: year-by-year, regime split, alternative roll)
00_MASTER §8 (store raw individual contracts, explicit roll tables)
per-symbol §9 backtest protocol: individual expiry contracts, walk-forward OOS

needs.daily_trades_per_contract: real-volume daily OHLCV per individual expiry, >= 5y continuous, all listed expiries
needs.definitions_reference: full listing/activation + expiry calendar per root (PIT, no lookahead)
needs.open_interest: daily OI per contract (liquidity migration, PIT contract selection)
needs.settlement: official settlement per contract-day (exchange-event truth, separable from trade close)

HC2_intraday_execution.description: Intraday execution realism: session statistics, entry-delay tests, spread/depth response, fill realism.
framework_refs: per-symbol §10 data checklist (bbo-1m/bbo-1s selective; mbp-1 execution/microstructure validation)

needs.minute_trades_m1: continuous M1 per-contract multi-year (session stats, delayed-entry)
needs.bid_ask_intraday: synchronous BBO at <=1m (executable spread, not asynchronous EOD quotes)
needs.statistics_settlement_oi: official OHLC/volume/OI to reconcile bars vs exchange truth

HC3_roll_critical_windows.description: Roll windows and term structure: calendar vs volume vs OI roll, roll cost, back-adjustment sensitivity, vendor-stitch jump audit.
framework_refs: 00_MASTER §8 (roll tables: old/new, decision ts, reason, volume/OI, gap, adjustment)
per-symbol §6 (compare calendar roll vs volume roll vs OI roll; verify no vendor-stitch jump is alpha)

needs.daily_trades_per_contract: ADJACENT contracts' simultaneous real-volume daily bars across full history (roll cost = adjacent close gap)
needs.open_interest: daily OI of old + new contract at roll decision time (PIT roll rule)
needs.definitions_reference: exact listing/expiration timestamps (roll decision uses only pre-known info)

HC4_event_study_windows.description: Event studies around scheduled releases (FOMC/CPI/NFP for NQ/ES/6*, EIA storage for NG/CL, CoT for positioning).
framework_refs: 00_MASTER §5 (returns at 1m/5m/15m/1h/1d; spread+volume response; event timestamp in exchange tz + UTC)
00_MASTER §7 (PIT: release timestamp, tz, vintage, earliest observable ts)

needs.minute_trades_m1: M1 (or tick) around event timestamps, multi-year = many event repetitions
needs.external_pit: release timestamps + as-known-then values (ALFRED vintages, CFTC CoT release times, EIA/BLS schedules) — NOT_SOLVED_BY_VENDOR, see DATA_ACQUISITION_SPEC.md

gap_types.DEPTH_WALL_EXPIRED_RESOLUTION: IBKR expired-contract secdef resolves only ~1y back (FUTURES-DATA-10SYMS-V1 finding 1): per-contract REAL-VOLUME daily chain is only ~14-17 months (measured front-chain run); older expiries unresolvable => cannot extend via IBKR retrospective fetch.
gap_types.INTRADAY_VINTAGE_WALL: IBKR intraday (M1/H1) availability ~10 recent months for these entitlements (NG ~2.2y; FUTURES-DATA-10SYMS-V1 finding 4 / S7_DEPTH_ACTIVE.json probes at 2024/2022 ends returned n=0). On-disk corpus is a snapshot: 2 trading days of M1 and ~30 days of H1 per contract, not continuous history.
gap_types.SETTLEMENT_ONLY_DEEP_BARS: 65-88% of on-disk daily bars are close-only O=H=L=C with volume=0 (settlement-derived; measured per symbol below): usable as reference/signal price, NOT as fill price or volume evidence (FUTURES-DATA-10SYMS-V1 finding 3).
gap_types.CLASS_ABSENT_OPEN_INTEREST: IBKR bar files carry no open-interest field: OI class NOT_AVAILABLE in current corpus.
gap_types.CLASS_ABSENT_STATISTICS: No exchange statistics schema (official OHLCV/OI/settlement publications) in IBKR corpus; settlement only inferable from close-only bars.
gap_types.CLASS_PARTIAL_DEFINITIONS: Definitions only as embedded file headers (expiry_month=lastTradeDate raw, timeZoneId) for the 10-28 fetched contracts + S1_IDENTITY.json for the ~1y resolvable window. No listing/activation dates, no full expiry universe, no PIT add/modify/delete history.
gap_types.BID_ASK_NONSYNCHRONOUS_1Y: Daily BID and ASK are separate non-synchronous series (~1y): spread computed from them is NOT an executable spread (FUTURES-DATA-10SYMS-V1 S6).
